title.zh: 社区影院访客服务助理

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Check admission bookings and provide accurate screen, seat and session information.
requirements.zh: 核对入场预订，并提供准确影厅、座位及场次信息。

requirements.en: Refer unconfirmed accessibility or seat-change arrangements to the duty manager.
requirements.zh: 将未确认无障碍或换座安排转交值班经理。

requirements.en: Track visitor-service issues and maintain clear manager handovers.
requirements.zh: 跟踪访客服务问题，并维护清晰的经理交接记录。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently build and run playlists on a cinema’s production playback system.
requirements.zh: 优先：独立在影院实际放映系统中建立并运行播放列表。
